verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an org-wide Dashboard that tracks review speed, code quality, collaboration patterns and the impact/ROI of AI-assisted reviews. A companion page defines each Git-platform review metric, which covers the core of an engineering lead's org-level visibility. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of acceptance-rate metrics for suggestions, explicit review-coverage metrics, a breakdown of findings by type, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.
